events.verdict: Wood (LAL) initiates more than marginal contact to Durant's (PHX) wrist just as he releases the ball during his jump shot attempt.
Vincent (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Nurkic's (PHX) path and absorbs the ensuing contact.  Vincent leans forward as the two players disengage, but he does not deliver contact.
Davis (LAL) firms up in a screening position in Gordon's (PHX) path and the ensuing contact as Gordon goes over the screen is marginal.
Durant (PHX) legally contests Wood's (LAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.

Reaves (LAL) is not established in a legal guarding position in Durant's (PHX) path when the contact occurs between the two players.  The illegal contact occurs just as Durant gathers the ball and is correctly deemed a shooting foul.
Gordon (PHX) places a forearm at James's (LAL) side and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Davis (LAL) establishes himself in Goodwin's (PHX) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Nurkic (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position as he moves alongside of James's (LAL) path to the basket.
Durant (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in Vincent's (LAL) path and spins away from him to avoid making any contact.
Reaves (LAL) moves laterally defending Durant (PHX) on the perimeter and the body contact is marginal.
Davis (LAL) and Wood (LAL) legally contest the jump shot attempt by Durant (PHX).  Any contact from Wood after the ball is released is marginal.
Allen (PHX) commits a take foul on Reaves (LAL).
Davis (LAL) and Durant (PHX) briefly engage and disengage with one another off ball.
Nurkic (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in Davis's (LAL) path and absorbs the contact.
Reaves (LAL) briefly places his arm to Goodwin's (PHX) side but the contact does not affect Goodwin's SQBR.
Goodwin (PHX) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
Gordon (PHX) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
